home.title: WELCOME
home.intro: My name is Carlos David Mesa, soon to be a systems engineer. Throughout my career, I have worked on various projects that have allowed me to grow both technically and professionally.
home.hobbies: I enjoy reading, playing chess, Parcheesi, and football.
home.quote: Programming entertains me so much that I do not feel a single day of work: "Choose a job you love, and you will never have to work a day in your life."

systems_engineer_unicauca.title: Systems Engineer
systems_engineer_unicauca.summary: I completed my studies in systems engineering with solid knowledge in systems analysis and design, programming, databases, and networks. Expected graduation in 2026.
developments: Web system for carbon footprint management and analysis developed for the Red Cross as a software engineering internship project.

frontend_jr_cmlexports.title: Junior Front-end Developer
frontend_jr_cmlexports.summary: I worked on the development and maintenance of the mobile application for international freight forwarding services, as well as implementing new features in the company’s internal CRM.
developments: Maintenance and development of new features for the international freight forwarding mobile app using React Native.
Participation in the development of the internal CRM with ReactJS on the frontend and NodeJS on the backend.

data_analyst_nexura.title: Junior Data Analyst
data_analyst_nexura.summary: I was responsible for data migration, transformation, and modeling using star schemas, working mainly with Pentaho PDI and Microsoft ETL tools.
developments: Design and implementation of ETL processes for data migration and transformation using Pentaho PDI.
Data modeling using star schemas optimized for querying and report generation.

fullstack_husj.title: Full-stack Developer
fullstack_husj.summary: I develop software tools for administrative and healthcare areas of the hospital. I have created real-time mobile applications and optimized processes that previously did not exist, improving staff productivity.
developments: Desktop application for rehabilitation attendance tracking that generates productivity data and improves staff time management, as well as analyzing patient behavior patterns.
Mobile application for real-time ambulance tracking and management of ambulance services using React Native and Firebase.
Suite of web tools for administrative management using Java Spring Boot on the backend and React TypeScript on the frontend, with clean architecture, microservices, and module federation.

enterprise_suite.title: Enterprise Application Suite
enterprise_suite.description: Design and development of an enterprise application suite aimed at automating administrative and healthcare processes. The system uses a microservices architecture in the backend and microfrontends in the presentation layer. Due to intellectual property restrictions, detailed functionality and internal architecture cannot be publicly disclosed.

attendance_monitoring_system.title: User Attendance Monitoring System
attendance_monitoring_system.description: Desktop application for file management and real-time analysis of attendance records. The system helps identify operational bottlenecks in physical rehabilitation services and is used by therapists and billing staff.

carbon_footprint_calculator.title: Corporate Carbon Footprint Calculator
carbon_footprint_calculator.description: SaaS web application designed to calculate corporate carbon footprints. Built with a multitenant architecture and microservices following a modular monolith approach. Led frontend development and contributed to backend implementation within a multidisciplinary team.

taxiok.title: TAXIOK – Taxi Request Platform
taxiok.description: Real-time taxi request platform including web and mobile applications, allowing users to request transportation services and drivers to manage ride requests.

parqueapp.title: ParqueApp – Parking Management Platform
parqueapp.description: Parking lot management platform with multitenant architecture and a serverless approach. Designed to support scalable deployments and customizable configurations for different parking operators.
